svg.title: OP-06 — NOT ONLY SQL: 22,000 particles. 20 chapters. Not only SQL.

g.text: A scroll-driven WebGL seminar on NoSQL: a 22k-particle GPU field
morphs through 20 chapters beside a 3D sharded cluster with hash
routing, replication and failover, plus a server-scored live quiz.
Live quiz leaderboard on MongoDB Atlas
